newsitem.title: USA: US sets guidelines for states' drinking water fund.
newsitem.headline: US sets guidelines for states' drinking water fund.

text.p: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency said Friday it released final guidelines for using the $9.6 billion Drinking Water State Revolving Fund.
EPA also said it soon will start awarding the first round of federal capitalization grants to states totaling $1.275 billion nationally.
Under the revolving loan fund program, authorized at $9.6 billion through 2003, the EPA awards grants to states which then provide loans and other assistance to qualifying communities.

The loans are for projects for drinking water quality and safety, with an emphasis on helping smaller drinking water systems have adequate technical, managerial and financial resources to provide safe water.
